observed: The frozen episode-inventory audit discovered two extra JSON objects because R6 diagnosis and obstruction records used top-level episode_id as a backlink.
resolution: Rename backlink fields to episode_pointer while keeping the episode, diagnosis and obstruction records distinct; recompute content-bound hashes and downstream trace evidence hashes.
reusable_search_guidance: Do not reuse reserved episode-discovery keys in non-episode evidence containers unless the canonical inventory contract explicitly admits them.
